name: Enthalpy v0.4.34
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.34

## Changes

- Area overviews now put tasks, active Projects, recent notes, the Area brief,
  and quick links in one workspace.
- The Areas navigation now supports search, archived Areas, and direct access
  to the selected Area files.
- Recent notes in an Area can open in a preview before they open in a new tab.
- Daily note file names now include the weekday, such as
  `2026-09-20-sunday.md`.

## Test this preview

Create or open a local workspace. Open an Area and confirm that its Overview
shows the Area brief, tasks, active Projects, recent notes, and quick links.
Open a recent note preview, then open the note in a new tab.

Create today's Daily note. In the workspace folder, confirm that its file name
contains the date and lowercase weekday.

## Known limits

This is a limited preview. Hosted Sync is not available. Work stays on this
device.
